latHint: Think what you count when you can't fall asleep.
pivHint: Paul urges us to do GOOD to all people. Jesus called himself the GOOD shepherd, who knows his ______ by name.
winText: You found it. GOOD isn't just what Paul urges us to do for all people. Jesus is the GOOD shepherd who knows his SHEEP.
lossText: The word was SHEEP. GOOD was the pivot. In John 10, Jesus calls himself the GOOD shepherd, who knows his SHEEP by name and lays down his life for them.
votdVerse: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.
passageText: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up. Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.
